output.summary: A climbing perennial flowering plant native to most of Africa except North Africa, tropical South and Southeast Asia, and south-central China, it uses curled leaf-tip tendrils for support. Its bright yellow-to-red flowers have wavy segments that bend backwards; most parts, especially the seeds and tubers, are poisonous, and ingestion can be fatal.
